pick.title: Select iZone bridge
pick.description: Bridges supporting the V2 local API were discovered on your network.

manual.title: Connect to iZone bridge
manual.description: No V2-capable bridge was discovered automatically. Enter the IP address of your iZone bridge.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, or the bridge does not support the V2 local API

abort.already_configured: This iZone system is already configured

update_favourite.name: Update favourite
update_favourite.description: Changes what an iZone favourite stores: one zone's mode and setpoint, the fan, and/or the AC mode. The change is saved on the controller, so the iZone app and wall controller see it too. Nothing is applied until the favourite is next activated.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The zone to change, by name as shown in the iZone app (any case), or its number (1 = first zone).

zone_mode.name: Zone mode
zone_mode.description: What the favourite does to the zone: open, close, or auto (temperature control). Leave out to keep the stored mode.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The zone's setpoint, 15-30 °C in 0.5° steps. Leave out to keep the stored setpoint.

fan.name: Fan
fan.description: The fan speed the favourite sets. Unset leaves the fan as it is.

mode.name: AC mode
mode.description: The AC mode the favourite sets. Unset leaves the mode as it is.

init.title: iZone options
init.description: Persistent notifications appear in Home Assistant when the controller says the filter is due a clean, and when a module's firmware changes.
